basic_info.description: Light-filled top-floor condo in a newer 18-unit boutique building. Located in the heart of the Marina, just steps from Chestnut Street's renowned shops, dining, and nightlife. Easy access to public transit, highway, Crissy Field, Marina Green, and Fort Mason. Open floor plan with abundant natural light and cityscape views. Updated kitchen with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, built-in microwave, and 4-burner gas range opens to dining area and living room. Quiet rear-facing bedroom. Updated bath with shower over tub. Includes 1-car garage parking, private storage, low HOA dues, and shared roof deck with stunning 180 views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, the Bay, and SF skyline. Don't miss!
